name: B10-0215/2025 (PPE) – Targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo – defending religious freedom and security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: defending religious freedom and security
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns terrorist attacks on Christians in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo by the Allied Democratic Forces, a group linked to Islamic State. It calls for those responsible to face justice, including at the International Criminal Court, and for new investigations. It backs joint Congolese-Ugandan military operations against the group, asks the European Union to consider sanctions and to help stop the group's funding, and supports peace efforts by Congolese churches. The text is a statement of position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks the European Union to consider sanctions and support for military efforts; no law changes yet.
- It affects Christians targeted in eastern Congo, armed groups there, and Congolese and Ugandan forces.
- Next: the resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission, Congo's government and international bodies.
